english.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice for a person who is treacherous, disloyal, or deceitful.

exampleSentences.english: He acts like your buddy on the surface, but he’s treacherous underneath.
exampleSentences.traditional: 佢表面同你稱兄道弟，其實好陰險。
exampleSentences.jyutping: keoi5 biu2 min6 tung4 nei5 cing1 hing1 dou6 dai6 kei4 sat6 hou2 jam1 him2

english.note: Use this instead of 邪惡 when the sinister quality involves deceit, underhandedness, or a hidden threat.

exampleSentences.english: They seem to help you, but secretly undermine you—they’re fiendish.
exampleSentences.traditional: 佢表面話幫你，背後卻搞小動作，真係好陰險。
exampleSentences.jyutping: keoi5 biu2 min6 waa6 bong1 nei5 bui3 hau6 koek3 gaau2 siu2 dung6 zok3 zan1 hai6 hou2 jam1 him2
